description: List the organization's reusable step Modules (modules are org-level, shared across projects — the same list as the Modules page). Supports name search and pagination. Reference a module by id when creating or editing a test case to include its steps (the Module itself is never changed).

folder_id.description: Only modules in this Modules folder (folder ids from tm_list_folders with tree="modules")

include_subfolders.description: With folder_id: also include modules from its subfolders

name: tm_list_modules
title: List Step Modules
